auth-remaining-from-file.name: Auth Remaining From File
auth-remaining-from-file.description: From their auth tracker and visit-count export, list authorized, used, and remaining only as those files already show.

day-close.name: Day Close
day-close.description: From their close report or drawer sheet, list tender types and amounts they recorded for one clinic date.

day-list.name: Day List
day-list.description: From the schedule export, list the day by time, therapist, type, and their patient label.

hep-print-index.name: HEP Print Index
hep-print-index.description: From their HEP library and the day list, list which charts have a therapist-attached or named HEP PDF ready to print.

no-show-list.name: No Show List
no-show-list.description: From the schedule or EHR export, list rows they already coded no-show, late cancel, or broken.

recert-dates.name: Recert Dates
recert-dates.description: From their recert or POC tracker and the referral folder, list recert due dates and POC end dates as stored.

referral-poc-completeness.name: Referral POC Completeness
referral-poc-completeness.description: From the referral folder, list inbound scripts and plans of care as complete or missing named pages and physician signature as their form requires.

visit-count-export-check.name: Visit Count Export Check
visit-count-export-check.description: Compare their visit-count export to the auth tracker for the charts they named.

wait-list.name: Wait List
wait-list.description: From their wait-list file, keep their order and requested type and therapist.

preseeded_role: Physical therapy front role (not the therapist)
